messages:
alex: FYI support ticket: customer observed double billing when a stream fell back to a smaller model and a toolcall truncated mid-response. logs attached.
alex: repro: start streaming -> primary route OOS -> fallback to small -> toolcall invoked -> toolcall truncated after 4 tokens -> client reconnects -> billing shows both original prefix and fallback charged.
morgan: do we have trace ids for the sessions?
alex: log excerpt: ```INFO route=primary sid=sessA tokens=42 at=2026-02-18T12:01:02Z -> fallback model=small at=12:01:05Z toolcall=tc_42 truncated_after=4 reconnect sid=sessA-1 billed_prefixes=[42,12]``` 

sam: my hunch: when router falls back we leave the provisional ledger for the original session intact and create a new provisional for fallback. both end up confirmed.
jin: yep. router creates provisional on accept; fallback currently spins up a new ephemeral session and hudles a separate provisional. confirm path doesn't dedupe across session ids.
dana: so options: cancel original provisional on fallback, or link fallback provisional to original so only one confirm wins.
rachel: UX ask: if we cancel, emit telemetry and surface in Console so customers/ops can see fallback-induced cancels (reduces surprise).
morgan: cancel semantics need to be CAS-safe. if commit races with cancel, ledger should either accept commit or report conflict and emit refund action.
sam: sketch: on fallback event do accounting.CancelProvisional(orig_session, reason="fallback", idempotent=true). Add metric accounting.fallback.cancel.{attempt,success,conflict}.
jin: pseudo:
```
if (fallback) {
  res = ledger.CancelProvisional(orig, ctx)
  emitTelemetry("accounting.provisional.cancel", {orig, fallback_to})
} else {
  ledger.Confirm(orig)
}
```

morgan: add dedupe on token ranges so reconnects replaying prefixes after cancel don't create new confirmed charge.
ops-bot: deploy planned: accounting/fallback-cancel feature-flagged to staging @ 2026-02-19T10:30Z
alex: feature flag please. want slow ramp.
rachel: will add ACCOUNTING_FALLBACK_CANCEL flag in Console with rollout toggle + telemetry dashboard panel.
sam: tests: add integration that simulates primary->fallback->truncated-toolcall->client-reconnect and assert billed tokens == single effective path.
jin: add ledger unit tests for Cancel vs Confirm race (simulate interleaved RPCs returning Conflict). ensure refunds/alerts created.
dana: edge: if cancel returns Conflict (because commit just won), emit audit event so finance can reconcile.
alex: I'll open PR with: 1) router hook to call CancelProvisional on fallback 2) telemetry event 3) metrics counters 4) feature flag guarded 5) integration test and ledger conflict test. assigning sam/jin for review.
morgan: can Console trace view show (primary -> fallback) with provisional vs confirmed badges? that'll cut down on support noise.
ops-bot: @oncall notified for staging window.
alex: filing support reply to customer: staged mitigation in progress, will follow up after verification. thanks team :pray:
